report_name: North West Leicestershire Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify potential cycling routes based on current commonality and growth potential, to investigate user number increases under different scenarios, and to inform the prioritisation of cycle route options.
other_tools_developed: Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT) and a Sustrans wide cost calculator tool
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP provides a prioritised programme of infrastructure improvements to make the case for future funding and to ensure cycling and walking are considered within local planning and transport policies.
pct_usage_quote: The PCT was used in the Cycling and Walking Strategy, almogside other sources of data, toidentify and prioritise the cycle route options incorporated into the LCWIP.
